interrupted_formal_attempts.incident: OS reboot interrupted unconfirmed native execution
interrupted_formal_attempts.counting: additional native launch attempt; not an additional planned condition or final failure

condition_accounting.planned_condition_equation: confirmed physical executions + reused conditions + unexecuted conditions = planned conditions (when complete)
condition_accounting.launch_attempt_equation: confirmed physical formal executions + additional interrupted formal attempts = total formal native launch attempts
condition_accounting.physical_formal_executions_definition: native launches with a finalized results.jsonl record; excludes interruption receipts
condition_accounting.interrupted_attempt_definition: formal native launch interrupted by host reboot, preserved in its receipt; kept separate from final condition results

limitations: Record/config hashes checked; binaries and large inputs not rehashed.
Archive verification metadata and file existence checked; gzip payload not reread.
Reboot receipt evidence checked without adding an extra planned condition or final failure.
Last epoch locates an observed stage, not the exact interrupted operation.
retry_failures is final unfinished count; zero does not mean no lock contention.

cohort.source_equivalence: SNAP origin is the named original distribution; SuiteSparse MTX byte/edgewise equivalence is not verified.
